attempts.label: DANDI:001354
attempts.paper_title: Synthetic GPCRs for programmable sensing and control of cell behaviour
attempts.entry_title: PAGER-Gi in hippocampal slices (Kalogriopoulos, Tei et al. 2024)
attempts.summary: None of the paper's main findings could be tested in this dataset, so none was confirmed or contradicted. The engineered receptors' antigen sensing, G-protein signalling, cell control and fluorescent sensor results rest on culture, imaging and biochemical data that were not deposited. The dandiset holds only the slice recordings behind the finding that PAGER-Gi neurons hyperpolarize more and need more current to fire with DCZ plus mCherry than with DCZ alone. Those comparisons could not be made because no file records which cells received which treatment or when DCZ was applied. The files also hold 50 cells where the paper analysed 41, with nothing marking which were used.
attempts.description: Tests the acute slice findings of Kalogriopoulos, Tei et al. (2024) on dandiset 001354, which holds whole-cell current clamp recordings of 50 CA1 neurons from 8 mice expressing anti-mCherry PAGER-Gi. The files do not record which cells received DCZ alone and which DCZ plus mCherry, when DCZ was applied, the mEGFP intensity of each cell, or the mCherry preincubation, so every claim is blocked. The notebook checks the files against the paper and computes the paper's per-sweep measures and exclusions for all cells.

outcomes.statement: Of 24 candidate dynorphin-derived antagonist peptides fused to the kappa-opioid DREADD, 16 auto-inhibited PAGER-TF, shifting the SalB EC50 more than tenfold.

outcomes.statement: The slice data comprise 15 cells from 7 mice recorded with DCZ alone and 26 cells from 6 mice recorded with DCZ plus mCherry.
outcomes.source: Methods, Neuronal electrophysiology assay in brain slices, Slice electrophysiology; Fig. 4i,j legend
outcomes.quote: Data were collected from n = 15 cells, 7 mice with DCZ, n = 26 cell, 6 mice DCZ + mCherry
outcomes.notes: Under reading (a) the dataset holds 50 cells from 8 mice (PK-109, 110, 113, 114, 115, 116, 119, 120), each cell in its own file with its own slice id; under reading (b), with either Rin window, the initial Rin exclusion removes one cell (PK-113, first-sweep Rin 525 megaohms) and keeps 49 cells from 8 mice. The paper's 15 plus 26 cells total 41; its 7 and 6 mice fit in 8 only if at least 5 mice gave cells to both groups, which the Methods allow. The per-condition counts the claim states cannot be formed. No file records which condition a cell was in (DCZ alone or DCZ plus mCherry) or when DCZ was applied. No file has an intervals group (no epochs, trials or time intervals), the analysis and processing groups are empty, and the session description is the same generic sentence in all 50 files. A scan of every attribute of every object, all sweeps included, and of every string dataset of any length, the text columns of the intracellular recording tables included, finds no drug, condition, timing or expression term; every sweep's series has the same description of a ramp stimulus, the stimulus description N/A and the comment no comments (notebook, Data check). The dandiset metadata names the two conditions only in its description. Each file is one continuous run of 5-s sweeps (15.5 to 26 min), so a change upon DCZ addition has no onset to be measured from, and the two groups cannot be formed. The totals alone rule out 'reproduced' under both readings, as no split of 50 or 49 cells gives 15 and 26. This assumes that every deposited cell was recorded in one of the two conditions, as the dandiset's description names only these two; if some were in neither, 41 of them could still split as 15 and 26. Had the conditions been recorded, the outcome could only have been partially or not reproduced, depending on the mouse counts. The 8 or 9 extra cells are not explained by any exclusion the paper states.
deviations: Rheobase, used only for the sweep exclusion here, is read from channel 1 (the current monitor), as the stored stimulus gives the ramp as a step to +500 pA; this is the criterion's "recorded stimulus" read from the channel that records it.

outcomes.statement: Every cell recorded with DCZ plus mCherry was preincubated in 1 uM mCherry for 30 to 150 min, 73.4 min on average.
outcomes.source: Methods, Neuronal electrophysiology assay in brain slices, Slice electrophysiology
outcomes.quote: All cells recorded with DCZ + mCherry also underwent a prior preincubation in mCherry (1 µM; range: 30–150 min, mean: 73.4 min)
outcomes.notes: The files hold no preincubation time and no record of which cells were preincubated; the paper gives only the range and mean. The paper deposited no other data (Data availability). No file records which condition a cell was in (DCZ alone or DCZ plus mCherry) or when DCZ was applied.

outcomes.statement: In acute hippocampal slices, PAGER-Gi-expressing CA1 neurons show a greater hyperpolarizing shift in resting membrane potential with 100 nM DCZ plus 1 uM mCherry than with DCZ alone (mixed linear model, Z = 3.17, P = 0.0015).
outcomes.source: Results, Customized cell behaviours driven by PAGER G, paragraph 3; Fig. 4i and legend
outcomes.quote: Neurons displayed a greater hyperpolarizing shift in RMP when presented with DCZ plus mCherry than with DCZ alone

statistics.n: 15 cells from 7 mice (DCZ) and 26 cells from 6 mice (DCZ plus mCherry)

outcomes.notes: No file records which condition a cell was in (DCZ alone or DCZ plus mCherry) or when DCZ was applied. No file has an intervals group (no epochs, trials or time intervals), the analysis and processing groups are empty, and the session description is the same generic sentence in all 50 files. A scan of every attribute of every object, all sweeps included, and of every string dataset of any length, the text columns of the intracellular recording tables included, finds no drug, condition, timing or expression term; every sweep's series has the same description of a ramp stimulus, the stimulus description N/A and the comment no comments (notebook, Data check). The dandiset metadata names the two conditions only in its description. Each file is one continuous run of 5-s sweeps (15.5 to 26 min), so a change upon DCZ addition has no onset to be measured from, and the two groups cannot be formed. The notebook computes RMP for every sweep (mean of 0 to 0.5 s) and applies the exclusions under both Rin windows and both detection rules, 10,429 to 10,884 sweeps of 49 cells kept, but cannot split them by group or by time from DCZ onset. A2 keeps more sweeps than A1 (10,884 against 10,429) mainly because it detects fast spikes that do not reach 0 mV, which A1 misses (456 sweeps with RMP at or below -50 mV, peaks -19.7 to -0.1 mV, concentrated in a few cells). Also blocked through methods-slice-sample, on which it depends.

outcomes.statement: The rheobase current needed to evoke action potentials increases more with DCZ plus mCherry than with DCZ alone (mixed linear model, Z = 2.60, P = 0.0093).
outcomes.source: Results, Customized cell behaviours driven by PAGER G, paragraph 3; Fig. 4j and legend
outcomes.quote: Similarly, the rheobase current needed to evoke action potentials increased in DCZ plus mCherry neurons, compared with DCZ-only samples

statistics.n: 15 cells from 7 mice (DCZ) and 26 cells from 6 mice (DCZ plus mCherry)

outcomes.notes: No file records which condition a cell was in (DCZ alone or DCZ plus mCherry) or when DCZ was applied. No file has an intervals group (no epochs, trials or time intervals), the analysis and processing groups are empty, and the session description is the same generic sentence in all 50 files. A scan of every attribute of every object, all sweeps included, and of every string dataset of any length, the text columns of the intracellular recording tables included, finds no drug, condition, timing or expression term; every sweep's series has the same description of a ramp stimulus, the stimulus description N/A and the comment no comments (notebook, Data check). The dandiset metadata names the two conditions only in its description. Each file is one continuous run of 5-s sweeps (15.5 to 26 min), so a change upon DCZ addition has no onset to be measured from, and the two groups cannot be formed. Rheobase is computed for every sweep from channel 1. In 10 of 50 cells the delivered ramp reaches +500 pA at 2.7 or 2.5 s, after 1.6 or 1.4 s (407.5 or 465.7 pA/s), where the Methods state 2 s (326 pA/s in the other 40 cells), the same in every sweep of a cell; a change within a cell is unaffected, but the stored stimulus does not show it. The criterion asks to show whether the holding current is constant. This cannot be shown: channel 1 reads 0.47 to 0.56 pA before any injection and varies by at most 0.037 pA within a cell, so either it does not include the holding current, which is then not recorded, or none was applied. This item of the criterion is not met. Rheobase under A1 and A2 agrees within 1 pA in 10,335 of the 10,675 sweeps with RMP at or below -50 mV where both rules detect an event; A2 is earlier by more than 10 pA in 335 sweeps, 325 of them in two cells (2024_08_07_0022 and 2024_08_07_0012) whose first spikes peak near -15 mV, and the per-cell mean differs by up to 336 pA. In the first 100 ms of the ramp A2 takes two deflections that peak at -49.3 and -55.8 mV for action potentials. Under A1, 5 sweeps fire in the first 100 ms of the ramp, at -147.5 to -112.3 pA; a test of rheobase would have to decide whether they count, as they would pull a cell's rheobase down. Also blocked through methods-slice-sample.

findings.statement: No file records the condition of its cell (DCZ alone or DCZ plus mCherry) or the time DCZ was applied. No file has an intervals group or a pharmacology or notes field, every sweep's series has the same generic description and the comment no comments, and the session description is the same generic sentence in all 50 files; the conditions are named only in the dandiset's description. The paper's slice comparisons (Fig. 4i,j, Extended Data Fig. 12b) cannot be made from the files.

The mEGFP intensity of each recorded cell (or the widefield images and soma ROIs it was measured from) and the mCherry preincubation time of each cell are not in the dandiset. Extended Data Fig. 12c-h and the preincubation figures of the Methods rest on them.

The files hold 50 cells from 8 mice; the paper analysed 41 cells (15 with DCZ, 26 with DCZ plus mCherry) from 7 and 6 mice. The paper's initial Rin exclusion (above 500 megaohms) removes one cell, leaving 49. Nothing in the files marks the cells the paper analysed or why the others were left out.

Channel 1 of every sweep (current_clamp-response-NN-ch-1) is a CurrentClampSeries with unit volts, but its values (-99.8 pA during the -100 pA step, -149.9 pA before the ramp, then the ramp) are the injected current in amperes.

The stimulus series (stimulus-NN-ch-0) gives the ramp as a step to +500 pA from 1.1 to 3.1 s in every sweep of every file. The current actually delivered, in channel 1, is a ramp from -150 pA, and its duration differs between cells.

In 10 of 50 cells (eight of the nine recorded on 2024-08-07, and 2024_07_24_0011 and 2024_07_26_0003) the delivered ramp reaches +500 pA at 2.7 s (407.5 pA/s) or 2.5 s (465.7 pA/s); the Methods state -150 to +500 pA across 2 s, which the other 40 cells receive (326 pA/s). Rheobase depends on the ramp's slope, so these cells are not comparable with the others on absolute rheobase. Every sweep also holds -150 pA for 100 ms before the ramp, which the Methods do not describe.

The files are sampled at 20 kHz; the Methods state digitization at 10 kHz. Neighbouring samples are equal no more often within pairs than across them, so the samples are not repeated. When each half of the samples of a file's first sweep is fitted on the 16 nearest samples of the other half, both residuals are 0.87 to 1.58 ADC counts; the same sweeps' even samples upsampled back to 20 kHz by linear, cubic or band-limited (FFT) interpolation give 0.30 to 0.57 counts. This is consistent with acquisition at 20 kHz; an upsampling the test does not model, such as one that adds noise, is not excluded.

Experimenter, lab and institution are "_" in every file, the electrodes and the device have no description, and the series have no stimulus description ("N/A") or comments. The holding current the Methods describe (adjusted so each cell began at -65 mV) is not recorded: the current monitor reads about 0.5 pA before any injection in every sweep.

paper_notes.statement: The paper's analysis scripts are available only on request, and the Methods do not define the windows that give a change "upon 2-min DCZ addition", the unit of the mixed linear model (one change per cell or every sweep), the action potential detection rule, or the steady-state window for input resistance. The question for the authors is which windows, unit, detection rule and Rin window were used, and which 41 of the 50 deposited cells were analysed, in which group?

entries.name: kalogriopoulos-2024
entries.title: PAGER-Gi in hippocampal slices (Kalogriopoulos, Tei et al. 2024)
entries.description: Tests the acute slice findings of Kalogriopoulos, Tei et al. (2024) on dandiset 001354, which holds whole-cell current clamp recordings of 50 CA1 neurons from 8 mice expressing anti-mCherry PAGER-Gi. The files do not record which cells received DCZ alone and which DCZ plus mCherry, when DCZ was applied, the mEGFP intensity of each cell, or the mCherry preincubation, so every claim is blocked. The notebook checks the files against the paper and computes the paper's per-sweep measures and exclusions for all cells.
